author: The Wonderful Team
title: Wonderful launches in the UK
bodyHtml:
Wonderful is launching in the UK, bringing its applied AI platform and forward-deployed strategy and engineering teams to one of the world’s most sophisticated enterprise markets.

The UK is not short of AI ambition, with world-class talent, leading academic research and robust thought leadership on policy.

But the market faces a unique set of challenges, which Wonderful is uniquely placed to address. British businesses, from SMEs to global brands, are suffering an AI execution gap. The scale of that gap is well documented. PwC research this year found that just 60% of UK businesses surveyed have a roadmap for AI, compared with 82% of the global AI leaders it identified. Many organisations have an active AI agenda and, in many cases, were early adopters of AI tools, but have yet to show evidence of realising the full potential of AI transformation. If UK companies fail to close this gap, they risk falling behind in a global race.

Wonderful has opened its first UK office in the heart of London and is investing in local teams and expertise to help businesses adopt AI faster and strengthen the country’s position as a market where the world’s most advanced AI is not simply developed or financed, but successfully put to work.

"UK organisations have no shortage of ambition or talent. What they need now is a partner who will take accountability for getting AI agents and systems safely and reliably into production inside complex, regulated environments. That is what we do. The Wonderful AI OS is designed to meet the governance, security and data-sovereignty requirements UK enterprises work under, and our teams build alongside customers so that what they create is theirs to own.”

Jason du Preez, GM, Wonderful UK and former Co-Founder of Privitar and VP of Salesforce.

We’ve built a strong team on the ground in the UK, and continue to expand. Explore our Careers page to see open roles and join us in shaping the future of applied AI.
